skills.name: Frost Shot
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Pela's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Frostbite
skills.desc: Removes #2[i] buff(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Pela's ATK to one designated target enemy.

skills.name: Zone Suppression
skills.desc:
Deals Ice DMG equal to #4[i]% of Pela's ATK to all enemies, with a #1[i]% base chance to inflict Exposed on all enemies.
When Exposed, enemies' DEF is reduced by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Data Collecting
skills.desc: If the enemy is debuffed after Pela's attack, Pela will restore #1[f1] additional Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack.

skills.name: Preemptive Strike
skills.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Pela deals Ice DMG equal to #4[i]% of her ATK to a random enemy, with a #1[i]% base chance of lowering the DEF of all enemies by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Bash
passives.desc: Deals 20% more DMG to debuffed enemy targets.

passives.name: The Secret Strategy
passives.desc: When Pela is on the battlefield, all allies' Effect Hit Rate increases by 10%.

passives.name: Wipe Out
passives.desc: When using Skill to dispel buff(s), increases the DMG dealt by the next attack by 20%.
